author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, BiGRU=160) — LR=7e-4 — seed=42
abstract: Learning-rate sweep for the best config to probe stability and potential APA/Spearman gains. Scalar-gated Conv+Pooling(mean↔LSE τ=0.25 len-norm) + BiGRU(160), post-fusion LayerNorm. BASE_SEED=42, lr=7e-4.
